item.title: 40-year-old Stan Wawrinka wins 4 and a half hour, 5-set match at 40 at the Australian Open
item.description: When we talk about older active tennis players, we often think of Novak Djokovic and his incredible form at the age of 38. But there's another tennis player in the elite which still thrills, and is even older: the Swiss Stan Wawrinka, who will turn 41 in May, and has just delivered one of the most thrilling matches of the Australian Open 2026 yet, beating 21-year-old qualifier Arthur Gea 4-6, 6-3, 3-6, 7-5, 7-6(3) in 4 hours and 33-minutes.
